card.name: Count words just before "times"
card.fires_on: Quantity words or verbs that come right before the word "times" or "time", such as many, several, seven, a number of, a few. It fires where the text is about to say how many times something happened.

modes.label: Quantifier before times
modes.description: A count or amount word sits right before the expected word "times".
modes.example: German Village was rebuilt<< several>> times during 1943.

modes.label: Verb or link word before times
modes.description: A verb or linking word where a frequency phrase is expected to follow.
modes.example: each number, 1 to 9,<< appears>> in every Column, Row, and Block

modes.label: Inside a number-of phrase
modes.description: The words "a number" or "of" in the phrase "a number of times".
modes.example: revised and expanded a number<< of>> times.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "times", "twice", and Chinese words for how many times (三次, 两次, 几次).
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say how many times something happened.
